name: New Year's Eve Party 🎆
author: Beatify
description: 101 songs for the last night of the year: countdown and midnight classics, party anthems and a few German favourites, from Bing Crosby in 1942 to Sam Smith in 2022. Requested in #3526.

songs.title: Let's Start the New Year Off Right

songs.title: My Baby Just Cares for Me
songs.fun_fact: Nina Simone recorded it in 1958. It became a UK hit in 1987 after being used in a perfume advertisement.

songs.title: What Are You Doing New Year's Eve?

songs.fun_fact_es: Frank Loesser escribió esta canción en 1947. La versión de Ella Fitzgerald apareció en su álbum navideño de 1960, Ella Wishes You a Swinging Christmas.
songs.fun_fact_fr: Frank Loesser a écrit cette chanson en 1947. La version d'Ella Fitzgerald figure sur son album de Noël de 1960, Ella Wishes You a Swinging Christmas.

songs.title: Build Me Up Buttercup

songs.fun_fact_nl: Mike d'Abo en Tony Macaulay schreven 'Build Me Up Buttercup'. In 1968 was het een top-vijfhit in zowel de VS als het Verenigd Koninkrijk.

songs.title: This Will Be Our Year

songs.title: Could You Be Loved
